notes.notes:

added pigs as a buildable animal
pigs breed if there are two or more close by; they breed fast
kill to harvest leather
removed robots and added them to the new blueprint system
blueprints for the robots are scattered throughout the wasteland; first area

notes.title: Getting ready for release
notes.notes: Probably nothing new for the next two weeks. I am playing through the game from start to finish, marking any bugs and squashing them. The XP is increased (probably too high tbh), but that is pretty much it.

notes.title: Almost Time To Release
notes.notes: You read that right. I am finally done. There are still a lot of things to do, though. I am doing a complete play-through, and a lot of Steam things are left to do. Also, keys will go out to streamers. If you know any that might be interested in playing my game, let me know.

notes.title: Update - patch notes 8/17/25
notes.notes:
It has been a while since I posted. I had some medical issues that made it difficult to finish the game. I might post more on this later, but Steam is for game updates, not my health :). I will try to push it through to the end. 

CHANGE LOG
- There are now cards that display an image and text at some key points in the story to add context and flair. Not all cards are in the game.
- added some quests for the new faction, the anura
- changed/updated the menu
- Had to do a bunch of backend stuff to add the cards and other systems I need to fish the game

notes.title: Build 0.8.13 - Update
notes.notes:
Change Log 9/6/24

Added the ability to drag out and build floors, walls, and roofs.
Did some internal changes to make the game more stable
Improved some dev tools to create levels/rooms faster
Finished the maze layout, just need to populate it with goodies.

notes.title: Update 8/24/24
notes.notes:
A button was added to fix/reset maps. Use this if you have bugs; this won't delete important things.
Made it so you can only have 2 followers follow you at a time. You can wear the crown to get 3.
Slowed down everything that moves (except projectiles) to make the combat feel smoother. See if you like it better. If you hate it let me know. The speed is set to 75% of what it was.
Updated a few sprites and fixed some text boxes.
 I am still working on the next chapter.

notes.title: Patch NOTES
notes.notes:
Hey, it has been a while! Expect some more updates coming up for the third chapter. I am now hard at work making the largest section of the game so far and it is a little more work than I thought it would be. Some of you might know I had some health issues at the beginning of the year and had to pause the actual production of the game (though I was still working through it in my mind (: ), but I am ready to start putting more updates out. I am fine BTW.

The section coming out is a large maze complex of interconnected caves. I am also working on the Anura race (frog people), which will inhibit the mountains and irradiated waters. Of course, those who have been around for a while know that art (for me) takes a lot of time. Programming I can do... art is getting faster?

Anyway here are some things I remember working on and are in the update:


Chairs, beds, and a few other things are now 4-way rotatable. If you think of others that should be able to be rotated in four positions let me know and I'll work them in.
After each major chapter unlock (Humans and Karkadann) you will unlock a new building menu that gives you unique buildings (ex: adobe buildings). I'll work on adding a few more things to these menus.
So many other things I am excited to show you but aren't viewable yet because they are in the new chapter.
Minor bug fixes and such and probably a lot I forgot.

Thanks again you guys for being patient with me :)

notes.title: Initial Update to current Stable Build
notes.notes:
More coming later but I need to test it. The upcoming build will complete the ACT 2 main story. I will then focus on a few side missions I would like to add before moving on to the 3rd ACT.

Thank you all for your patience as I navigate my new family structure :)

notes.title: Patch 1/20/23
notes.notes:
Lots of bug fixes and some spelling errors fixed
You can now disband NPC followers

notes.title: Patch (12/9/22)
notes.notes:
CHANGE LOG (12/9/22):

Traders no longer collide with blade spinners
Traders can now go through doors, but not gates (this is working as intended; gates are impassable for anyone but the player)
Photocells, alarms, switches, and pressure plates should now work correctly with wood burners.
You can no longer open the inventory while attaching devices
The Tool Bar should hide and show correctly now when attaching things. There is an "AIM BEFORE FIRING" message that pops up. Will fix this soon.
Deliverer robots amounts can now be added more quickly by holding down the button (like the trade booths). This was only a problem with the controller I believe (I used check_pressed instead of check).

notes.title: Update 12/8/22
notes.notes:
Change Log (12/8/22):
Car should now work as intended with controllers. A is accelerate, B is brake, and A+B is the handbrake. Let me know if you think of a better way to control it.
NPC Traders should avoid blade spinners. They should also be able to use gates and doors. (Not fully tested)
Added UI tip for trading booths, delivery robots, and wood burners that tell the player the key/button to press for multi items (Shift or Left Stick Button)
Wood burner should now save it's on/off state correctly.
Wood burner now works with switches.
Sand trap now works correctly with the controller. Works like sand wall.
Raid timer should now pause when in the pause menu.
Power/Mod bar has updated graphics showing which controller button to press (Temp ART and backward?).
Weapon bar should now hide when attaching things to things.

Special thanks to fodder for helping with finding all these bugs!

notes.title: Update: Encounters
notes.notes:
Change Log:

 There are now map encounters.
 These encounters appear as red crosses on the map and will chase you
 If they touch you you will be attacked
 There are only combat encounters. More will come later.


I've been working on more, but it has been awhile since I've updated the game so I thought I'd release a little update.
